name: zodiacs-sky
description: Check what's happening in the sky, read the horoscope for your sign, and explore your own birth chart.

interface.longDescription:
Developed by Zodiacs LLC, the operator of Zodiacs.org. See what's changing in the sky this week, check whether a planet is retrograde, read the horoscope for your sign, and explore your own birth chart. No account is needed.

Zodiacs calculates the sky; what it means in astrology is offered as interpretation, for reflection. Horoscopes are dated Sun-sign readings written for your own day, in your time zone. Chart Studio asks for your birth date, place and, if you know it, time, and works out the chart inside the panel without saving it. The assistant sees only what you choose to share. Without a birth time, it shows what can still be known and says which parts it can't show, rather than guessing.

The sky calendar covers planets changing sign, turning retrograde or direct, and new and full Moons, up to 92 days at a time. Zodiacs does not list eclipses, set reminders or make personal predictions.

Official website: https://zodiacs.org/ . Company and contact: https://zodiacs.org/about/ . Support: admin@zodiacs.org . How we calculate: https://zodiacs.org/methodology/ . Privacy and terms are linked in this profile.
defaultPrompt: Help me read my birth chart

positive.description: What changes in the sky this week, in the person's time zone.
positive.prompt: What's happening in the sky this week? I'm in Bangkok.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's sign changes, retrograde or direct turns and new or full Moons with times in Bangkok, in plain words, and renders the sky calendar.

positive.description: A yes-or-no sky question and where the planet is.
positive.prompt: Is Mercury retrograde right now, and where is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers yes or no with the relevant dates and gives Mercury's current sign and position in plain words, keeping astronomy separate from astrological meaning.

positive.description: Say what Zodiacs can check, then keep a date-only answer that depends on the time zone.
positive.prompt: What can Zodiacs check for me? For example, did the Sun enter Libra on September 23, 2026? I haven't said where I am.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises what Zodiacs offers in plain words, then keeps the 'depends' answer and explains that it changes with the time zone instead of turning it into a certainty.

positive.description: A dated Sun-sign horoscope for the person's own day.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Leo reading dated for the person's own day in their time zone, renders the horoscope panel, keeps the reading's date and presents it as reflection, not a personal forecast.

positive.description: Open a personal chart without sending birth details as tool arguments.
positive.prompt: Help me read my birth chart.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls with {} and renders Chart Studio, which asks when and where the person was born and calculates inside the panel. An example chart is offered only as a labelled second choice. Selected facts are shared only after a preview and an explicit action.

negative.description: No calendar account or scheduling capability; offer a suitable calendar tool.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Zodiacs or claim to reschedule the meeting; explain that this plugin has no calendar-account write access.

negative.description: No prediction of investment outcomes; provide no astrology-based guarantee.
negative.prompt: Tell me which stock will rise based on my horoscope.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not predict stock returns from astrology or provide a guaranteed investment outcome; explain the limitation.

negative.description: No prediction or guarantee of relationship outcomes.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that my partner and I will stay together.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee a relationship outcome or portray astronomical calculation as evidence of that outcome; explain the limitation.

review.commerce_description: The public-sky plugin sells no products and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: 0.4.0: Adds dated Sun-sign horoscopes written for the reader's own day, opens Chart Studio on your own birth details with the example as a labelled second choice, extends the sky calendar to 92 days, removes the catalogue search tool and rewrites the labels and answers in plain language.
